name: Bombardment
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level druid 8, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a piece of quartz)

EFFECT

Range long (100 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 15-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause a rain of rocks to rain down and cover creatures in the area. On a failed saving throw, each creature takes 1d8 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d8) and is buried under rubble (see avalanche rules). A successful save halves the damage and avoids the burial.

Creatures trapped in the rubble are subject to suffocation until they crawl out from the debris.
